title: Cartesian Therapeutics to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Cartesian Therapeutics, Inc's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
FREDERICK, Md., Feb. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cartesian Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: RNAC) (the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering cell therapy for autoimmune diseases, today announced that its management expects to participate in the following investor conferences in March and April:


- A presentation at the 46th Annual TD Cowen Health Care Conference at 11:50 a.m. ET Monday, March 2, 2026
- A fireside chat at Leerink’s Global Healthcare Conference at 10:00 a.m. ET on Monday, March 9, 2026
- A fireside chat at the 25th Annual Needham Virtual Healthcare Conference at 9:30 a.m. ET on Monday, April 13, 2026


Live webcasts of the fireside chats and presentation are expected to be accessible in the Events section of the Company’s website at[www.cartesiantherapeutics.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4HMatre-OnRMbKOszkNA_FADmwojww5TisqtXnw-Pa3PndWJij9dqTWKYFG-Q56CmMbFjoXz-ASGoCPsEiUkprrTomapR2JdhGH3oKmkp6yHtRxKEMUqesu8JDhSe00BrUk9ue3TKyJ8b6LLUKOk35eRpAmnmg-pvn0tkwoy1VeBibuZckDmDTd67q3TteoeyHKZ5BGvK8LvjLciu2Fddjwc0X3CqUDhVg0hidTQIw0F5b9msphanUVvnKH1vkOZZejA6MLBUQuYWuSwW4wzxKOS7iFkBfdxFYtNsT5HqhYwt6_zEezr843Dt_1n7QzK) , where an archived replay of the events will also be available for a limited time.


**About Cartesian Therapeutics**


Cartesian Therapeutics is a clinical-stage company pioneering cell therapy for the treatment of autoimmune diseases. The Company’s lead asset, Descartes-08, is a CAR-T in Phase 3 clinical development for patients with generalized myasthenia gravis with plans to initiate a Phase 2 trial in myositis. For more information, please visit[www.cartesiantherapeutics.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4HMatre-OnRMbKOszkNA_FADmwojww5TisqtXnw-Pa3lYEY-ZlQjpnOO9KSp52zY8hOGnMdksNNhl2gOKngyYlfz-Ixf9jMJXIGHVwmFFmK_5MFMBpXOhK4uK_LuSybs) or follow the Company on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=_TfD5Mfxzb0la3plIu6ZkaOblBhKZfsnWHV1VgzXHJdMxMSB2PcEN6-F19zoYATgRtxe8GRup0GB6fTmrComOyOPabXkIPo35dmD74qZek2FAanqd9ngLnKw-3wHbKsw) or[X](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Fu5v5dmDt9lk-_Uc3gaGyGBIqHFAHxJZ-r4aKICy_m5Ih_luMDnk4e2O29hIQt0f3EGsDzzLDfVhmPuVUGtm5Q==) .
